unchanged.description: Rows that match a record that already has these values.

errors.description: Problems found in the file. The same number as `errors_total`.

counts.description: What the import would do, counted.

row.description: The row the problem is in, counted from 1 over the records of the file, so the header of a CSV is not counted. 0 marks a problem with the file as a whole.

column.description: The column as named in the file. Empty when the problem is not about one column.

value.description: The value as found in the file.

reason.description: What is wrong with it, in words.

items.description: A row, column and value that stop the import, with the reason.

errors.description: The problems found, in file order, at most 1,000; `errors_total` is the exact number.

errors_total.description: The exact number of problems found.

mirror_scope.description: Where `mirror` would delete records: `collection` is every record of the collection, which the preview should say prominently; `filter` and `robot` are the scope that was sent. Null when the mode is not `mirror`.

warnings.description: `plan_limit`: importing the file would take the organization over a limit of its plan, so the import itself would be refused.

token.description: Stands for exactly this import: send it as `confirm` to carry it out. Null while the file has errors.

description: The preview of an import: what it would do, the problems that stop it and the token that confirms it.
